title: Cataloging the Arcane
description: Library duty is where the Circle puts every new Novice, not to teach you the schools of magic but to see whether you can be trusted around them unsupervised. A necromancy tome has been sitting on an open shelf for who knows how long - any patron touring the Athenaeum, or worse, any Magister with a grudge against Elara, could have found it there first. Shelve it properly and get it into the vault before somebody else notices what she missed.

objectives.description: Shelve the Athenaeum's texts properly, five cases of them
objectives.notes: Interact with 5 different bookshelves to organize them

objectives.description: Find the necromancy tome shelved where any visitor could reach it
Get it into the restricted vault before anyone else sees where it was
Tell Elara what you found and where it was sitting

notes: Threat: a necromancy tome sitting unsecured where any visitor - patron or rival Magister - could have found it first. Giver motive: a misfiled forbidden text is Elara's mistake, and finding it before somebody else does is the only way it never becomes one. Consequence: unwired - the quest never lets the tome actually be found by anyone but the player, so the exposure it threatens never lands; a later pass could make failing this in time cost Elara a council rebuke. Second quest, Novice rank.
